messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran the KB link scanner and hit a 404 on /kb/onboarding/setup-provisioning.md. It breaks the 'First week' quickstart anchor. Anyone own that page?

devon: I can take a look. If it was moved we can add a redirect. Assign it to me and I'll open a quick PR.

jamal: IIRC that content was moved into /kb/setup/infra-provisioning during the restructure last year. The custodian used to be platform-infra but not sure who currently owns it.

kevin: If owner is unknown, quick pattern is: add redirect frontmatter + set custodian to the team handle, then ping the team for a proper owner. Minimal PR to restore the quickstart is fine.

maria: Thanks — Devon, if you do the PR please add this frontmatter snippet to the moved page:

```yaml
---
redirect_from: "/kb/onboarding/setup-provisioning.md"
custodian: team-platform-infra
---
```

Also add one-line note to the docs changelog so the sweepers pick it up.

devon: On it. Will open a PR in ~30m. @docs-bot can you run a link-scan after merge? :eyes:

docs-bot: Auto-note: I'll enqueue a link-scan after the PR is merged. :gear: If you set `custodian` to a team handle (e.g. team-platform-infra) it will show up in the ownership report and the next sweep will notify the team.

maria: :thumbsup: Can someone in platform-infra confirm the real page owner once PR is up? @jamal can you ping them?

jamal: Yep — I'll ping Alice and Priya in platform-infra and loop back here with whoever claims it.
